title: 建築エンジニアリング総合演習Ｂ
subtitle: Architectural Integrated Exercises for engineering B
teachers:
TSUCHIDA Yoshio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Structural design of RC structure and steel structure
educationalGoal: Integrated exercises in the structural and environmental fields of architecture are conducted. Students will understand the physical phenomena related to architecture through experiments and exercises as well as specialized environmental measurement techniques and structural design methods. They will acquire the ability to apply such knowledge and techniques in practice. Furthermore, through the process of doing the experiments and exercises, students will be able to discover various problems encountered in actual design.
advice:
1. Environmental experiments
-Experiments and exercises related to air, heat, and energy
 * Select one of the themes “Air” or “Heat/Energy” and conduct experiments and exercises related to environmental design.
-More specialized experiments and exercises
 * Select a theme such as “Heat”, “Air”, “Sound”, “Light”, or “Green in the city” on which to conduct more specialized experiments and exercises.
2. Structural design of RC + S building or experiment of wooden structure
 * Select one of the themes "Structural design"  or "Experiment"
-Design of RC + S building
Design a mixed structure including RC and S structures. Various conditions related to the design will be specified in each lecture.
-Experiment of wooden structure
Execute a lateral loading test of wooden structure with shear wall and microtremor measurement.

* Please note that many points are deducted for absences.

requiredKnowledge:
(Environmental field) Proactively prepare for each theme and try to find issues to consider. Review the textbooks and class notes from the first and second years and confirm the contents. Wear clothes that allow you to work safely. Always bring your PC, notebook, and writing instruments to organize the data.
(Structure field) Review textbooks and lesson notes for courses taken in the first, second, and third years and confirm them. Since this exercise is linked to “Structural Design of Architecture” which is offered during the same semester, taking this course is strongly recommended.

2. Structural design of RC + S building or experiment of wooden structure

-Design of RC + S building
Design a mixed structure including RC and S structures. Various conditions related to the design will be specified in each lecture.
-Experiment of wooden structure
Execute a lateral loading test of wooden structure with shear wall and microtremor measurement.
